title: Union Berlin and Schalke Face Off in Decisive Bundesliga Clash
seoTitle: Union Berlin vs Schalke: Decisive Bundesliga Clash
subtitle: Both clubs seek their first win of the season in a match scheduled for September 11
excerpt: Union Berlin and FC Schalke 04 meet in the 3rd round of the Bundesliga, both winless. The clash, set for September 11, promises to be intense and decisive.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Union Berlin and FC Schalke 04 will face each other in Matchday 3 of the 2026/27 Bundesliga, searching for their first win of the campaign. The matchup is highly anticipated as both clubs enter the game without points and urgently need to climb the table.

Why the match is in the spotlight

The match, scheduled for September 11 at 20:30 (German time), brings together two teams that have yet to win in the first two rounds. The lack of victories makes this clash decisive in the fight for higher positions.

Current standings and recent form

Union Berlin occupies 15th place with just one point, having conceded seven goals in two matches, including a 0-4 defeat against Bayer Leverkusen. The team scored three goals against Eintracht Frankfurt, but the defense still shows fragility.

FC Schalke 04 is in 14th place, also with one point, after losing 0-3 to Augsburg and drawing 0-0 with Bayern Munich. The club has yet to score in the league, although they won 5-2 in the DFB-Pokal against Hallescher FC.

Available squads

Both teams have full squads available, with no reported injuries. Union Berlin relies on goalkeeper F. Rønnow and a defense of F. Uduokhai, J. Juranović, T. Rothe, and Z. Van Den Bosch. In midfield, A. Kemlein, L. Burcu, Michel Aebischer, and Rani Khedira are options, while the attack features E. Latte Lath, M. Ljubičić, and others.

Schalke has Loris Karius in goal, with a defense of H. Kuruçay, Nikola Katić, T. Becker, and R. Gosens. In midfield, D. Ljubičić and E. Ebimbe feature, and the attack includes S. Tanaka, A. Aouchiche, Soufian El-Faouzi, and M. Sylla.

Head-to-head statistics

In the last six meetings, Union Berlin and Schalke 04 had one draw, four shared victories, and a single matchup decided by each team. The most notable result was Union Berlin's 6-1 victory in the 2022/23 season.

On average, Union Berlin has recorded 5.0 goals per game in the first two rounds, while Schalke has averaged 1.5 goals per game.

Predictions and betting options

Analysis indicates that the game should be balanced, with low chances of a draw. Projections point to under 2.5 total goals and suggest that betting on a draw-no-bet option could be interesting.

For those watching the broadcast, the clash will be shown live on Sky Sport Bundesliga and Sky Bundesliga 1, with streaming available via WOW or Sky Go starting at 19:30.
